items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Kokayi and Sub-Zero. [INTERVIEWEE] Those cats sit there and made up stuff about me...

ctx.x: Yeah, first was happening, yeah. So now it’s been going on, what? – about 20 years. I hear cats. Boy, they – like, you brought some guys by the club, didn’t hardly even know my name.

Those cats sit there and made up stuff about me, and it’s just – and you were playing one of the latest tunes. You were playing, I think [Freeman hums the first phrase of Mr. P.C.] one of Trane’s tunes, and these cats was doing it to death. Everybody said, “How are those cats doing it?” I said, “I don’t have a clue.”
